about_the_game:
One needs to consider the fragility of life and remember that everything is temporary, even your looks. Drink from your own reflection, do not fade into normalcy. The Porcelain Observer Pack contains 2 Legendary Outfits, 4 cell items and a player icon.  

 

 The Porcelain Observer Pack includes the following: 

  • Poor Harley Suit 

  • Quin The Ponce Suit 

  • Baroque Mirror cell item 

  • World Globe cell item 

  • Sextant cell item 

  • Framed Insects cell item 

  • A player icon
